tools.name: teams_list
tools.description: List all sub-teams (cost-center budget pools) for the authenticated client tenant, including current period spend and member counts.

includeMembers.description: Include assigned staff member summaries on each team.

tools.name: teams_create
tools.description: Create a new sub-team with optional monthly budget cap, default role, endpoint allowlist/blocklist, initial members, defaultCostCenter, allowedCostCenters, and enforceCostCenter lock.

defaultRole.description: Optional default system role slug for members.

parentTeam.description: Optional parent Sub-Team ID to form a regional/department hierarchy.

defaultCostCenter.description: Optional CostCenter ID used as default when caller omits x-cost-center.

allowedCostCenters.description: Allowed CostCenter IDs for this sub-team when enforceCostCenter is enabled.

enforceCostCenter.description: When true, reject requests whose x-cost-center is not in allowedCostCenters or defaultCostCenter.

monthlyBudget.description: Monthly credit budget cap in USD (null for unlimited).

tools.name: teams_update
tools.description: Update an existing sub-team's metadata, budget cap, CECO lock policy, endpoint policy, or assigned member list.

parentTeam.description: Optional parent Sub-Team ID (or empty/null to make root team).

tools.name: teams_delete
tools.description: Delete a sub-team and optionally reassign its members and owned resources to another sub-team ID.

reassignToTeamId.description: Optional target sub-team ID for reassignment.

tools.name: teams_assign_resources
tools.description: Bulk-assign or unassign existing workspace resources (projects, flows, templates, batch configs, batches, reports, requests) to a sub-team (requires team.update and team.readAll).

id.description: Target sub-team ID, or 'unassigned' to clear team ownership.

visibility.description: Optional shared visibility override for config resources.

tools.name: teams_create_api_key
tools.description: Generate a Sub-Team-scoped API key JWT carrying { clientId, teamId } so server integrations obey that team's CECO, endpoint, and budget rules.

alias.description: Human-friendly label for the API key.

tools.name: roles_catalog
tools.description: Retrieve the full RBAC catalog including resources, actions, built-in system presets (including report_builder), and tenant custom roles.

tools.name: roles_create
tools.description: Create a custom tenant role with granular resource/action permissions, endpoint policy, and access-request policy.

basedOn.description: Optional system role preset slug to seed defaults from.

allowAccessRequests.description: Whether staff on this role may submit self-service access requests.

requestableResources.description: Optional allowlist of requestable resource keys (null for unrestricted).

tools.name: roles_update
tools.description: Update an existing custom role's permissions, metadata, or access-request policy.

tools.name: roles_duplicate
tools.description: Clone any built-in system role preset (e.g. report_builder, operator) or custom role into an editable custom role.

id.description: System role slug or existing ClientRole ID.

name.description: Optional name for the cloned custom role.

tools.name: roles_delete
tools.description: Delete a custom role, optionally reassigning affected staff members to another system or custom role.

tools.name: staff_list
tools.description: List workspace staff members along with their role, custom role, and assigned sub-team.

tools.name: staff_invite
tools.description: Invite a new staff member and assign them a system role, custom role, and optional sub-team.

role.description: System role slug (e.g. admin, team_manager, compliance_officer, developer, finance, operator, report_builder, viewer).

additionalTeams.description: Optional additional Sub-Team IDs for cross-team access or management.

tools.name: staff_update
tools.description: Update an existing staff member's role, custom role, primary/additional sub-team assignments, or custom permission overrides.

role.description: System role slug (including team_manager and report_builder).

tools.name: staff_my_permissions
tools.description: Inspect the authenticated caller's effective RBAC permissions matrix, assigned sub-team, CECO policy, and access request policy.

tools.name: access_requests_list
tools.description: List tenant self-service access, role upgrade, and budget increase requests.

tools.name: access_requests_approve
tools.description: Approve a pending staff access, role upgrade, or budget boost request.

tools.name: access_requests_reject
tools.description: Reject a pending staff access request.

tools.name: access_requests_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a previously approved temporary access grant immediately.

tools.name: cost_centers_list
tools.description: List active Cost Centers (CECOs) configured on this account.

tools.name: cost_centers_create
tools.description: Create a new Cost Center (CECO) code for billing attribution and sub-team locking.

country.description: ISO-2 country code (e.g. CO, MX, PE).

tools.name: usage_cost_center_statement
tools.description: Generate the monthly Cost Center (CECO) & Sub-Team usage statement (API requests + SmartReport credits + top 5 endpoints). Does not consume credits.

period.description: Billing month YYYY-MM (defaults to current UTC month).

tools.name: staff_audit_logs_list
tools.description: Query the immutable team-scoped RBAC & Staff audit trail (role updates, access approvals, team assignments, signed downloads).

action.description: Optional action filter (e.g. staff.update, team.create, access_request.approve).

tools.name: smart_report_create_signed_link
tools.description: Mint a short-lived HMAC-signed PDF download URL (max 24h TTL) for sharing a SmartReport without bearer auth headers.

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime in seconds (60 to 86400; defaults to 3600).
